title: Weekly knowledge history and a scheduled knowledge run
description:
Needs Papyrus:
- Archive the knowledge snapshot every week, including cluster identity (new, continued, merged, split), starting now: cluster history cannot be backfilled. Trend counts can be backfilled from item dates.
- Move the manual workstation run (BERTopic plus GLiNER2) to a scheduled job in AWS, with the stale-checkout guard.

The River, "The map this week" and "Concepts born this week" depend on this.

Acceptance: two consecutive weekly archives exist, and the River shows both weeks from real data.
